summary: Picking tag values is quicker, and the Tag types page loads again.

new.title: Tag values picked from a dropdown
new.text: In the rule editor and the rules grid, a tag type with a value list now offers exactly those values. An older value no longer on the list stays visible and marked.

fixes.title: Tag types page loads again
fixes.text: The Tag types page showed 'Could not load' when two rules set the same value. It loads again.
